analysis.title: Nvidia Corp. (NVDA): Our thoughts on the company's announced management transition
key_insights: On Nov 12 Nvidia announced that CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and as a director. CFO Colette Kress becomes Interim CEO while remaining CFO, effective immediately, and the Board is searching internally and externally for a permanent CEO. Harvey C. Jones was elected Board Chair.
GS calls the announcement a meaningful but measured negative for the stock. It keeps the Buy rating and cuts the 12-month price target to $220 from $300.

Strategic and ecosystem: GS sees a strong functional-level bench but no senior leader with Huang's vision, reach and convening power. It expects Nvidia to fulfill announced commitments, but new multi-party ecosystem investments at the same scale may be harder to negotiate.

Leadership and culture: GS sees Huang as integral to Nvidia's culture, so operating as nimbly may be harder without him. Rubin Ultra and Feynman execution is already well underway, but GS sees heightened execution risk over the next 12-18 months.

Financial: the DOJ is reportedly investigating whether some Nvidia customers violated export controls after shipments to jurisdictions including Singapore. Nvidia's operations in certain jurisdictions could face more scrutiny. The FY26 10-K put sales exposure to mainland China, Hong Kong and all other regions outside the US and Taiwan at 11%.

GS expects a measured direct hit to financials and earnings power over 12-18 months because of the 12-24 month backlog and order book and a roadmap defined for 2-3 years. It expects a larger hit to the multiple because of the uncertainty. Shares were already at a wide discount to the market on concern that AI infrastructure growth could slow without Nvidia or competitor financing.

Apple analog: from about 18 months before Steve Jobs's death in October 2011, Apple de-rated from about 17x to about 12x NTM P/E, troughed near 9x in 2013, then recovered to about 15x once product execution continued. GS says the analogy is imperfect but expects the market to search for Nvidia's right multiple until leadership and business momentum are clearer.

Valuation: GS CY27 EPS of $16.70 versus Street $15.91 (Bloomberg) implies 9.6x (GS) and 10.1x (Street) P/E. GS sees favorable risk/reward given about 80% expected EPS growth. The new target applies 22x (down from 30x) to normalized EPS of $10.00 (unchanged), about 13x forward EPS.

market_movers.rationale: Buy retained on positive risk/reward over 12-18 months. The target multiple falls to 22x from 30x on limited visibility, the management transition and execution risk, with normalized EPS unchanged at $10.00. Price was $173.73, implying 26.6% upside.

earnings_insights: GS CY27 EPS estimate $16.70 versus Street $15.91 (Bloomberg). Both are forecasts. Implied P/E 9.6x (GS) and 10.1x (Street).
GS normalized EPS estimate $10.00 (unchanged, forecast), roughly equal to its trailing 12-month earnings estimate. This is the base for the $220 target.

GS fiscal-year EPS: FY ending 1/26 $4.52 (reported), 1/27E $9.40, 1/28E $16.70, 1/29E $23.00 (all GS forecasts). Revenue estimates $412.7bn for 1/27E, $718.3bn for 1/28E and $955.0bn for 1/29E, against $215.9bn for 1/26.
GS quarterly EPS: 7/26 $2.22 (shown without an E marker), 10/26E $2.50, 1/27E $2.81, 4/27E $3.21 (GS forecasts).

trade_ideas.description: Buy NVDA shares with a 12-month price target of $220 (26.6% upside from $173.73)
trade_ideas.rationale: Positive risk/reward on fundamentals over the next 12-18 months, with about 80% expected EPS growth at a 9.6x implied CY27 P/E.
trade_ideas.risk: Ongoing uncertainty around the management transition, increased operational and execution risk, potential slowing in customer activity or order levels, and ongoing internal and external investigations.

risk_factors: Ongoing uncertainty around the management transition
Potential slowing in customer activity or order levels
Ongoing internal and external investigations, including the DOJ export control probe
Greater difficulty negotiating new multi-party ecosystem investments at prior scale
Situation is fluid and additional information could change GS's view
vol_and_positioning: Nvidia shares were already trading at a wide discount to the market before the announcement. GS attributes this to investor concern that AI infrastructure growth could slow sharply without financing from Nvidia or its competitors.
geopolitical: US Department of Justice investigation into whether some Nvidia customers committed export control violations after product shipments to jurisdictions including Singapore.

tension_points.bull_case: Direct impact on financials is likely measured over 12-18 months given the 12-24 month backlog and a roadmap well into execution. At 9.6x GS CY27 EPS with about 80% EPS growth, risk/reward is favorable. The Apple analog shows multiples recovered once execution continued.
tension_points.bear_case: No successor has Huang's vision and convening power, so new ecosystem financing deals may be harder to land. Execution risk rises over 12-18 months, the DOJ export control probe may bring more scrutiny, and the multiple could compress as Apple's did from about 17x to about 9x.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The report names no level. Its listed downside risks are slowing customer activity or order levels and adverse results from ongoing internal or external investigations.
